topHook: 7 in 10 online carts never check out

scenes.vo: [calm, curious] Seven in ten online carts are abandoned before checkout.
scenes.label: online carts abandoned

scenes.vo: That's the average across dozens of studies.
For shoppers who were ready to buy, the number one reason they left: extra costs at checkout. Shipping, taxes, fees.
scenes.label: for shoppers ready to buy

scenes.vo: [curious] And nearly one in five left because the site made them create an account.
[quiet] Show the full price early, let them check out as a guest. Because right now,
